mapper.update: UPDATE dag_node_instance SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_expire_time = #{leaseExpireTime}, attempt = attempt + 1, error_msg = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND deleted = 0 AND version = #{version}
UPDATE dag_node_instance SET status = 'PENDING', next_retry_time = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE status = 'RETRYING' AND next_retry_time <= #{now} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE dag_node_instance SET status = 'PENDING', lease_owner = NULL, lease_expire_time = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expire_time < #{now} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE dag_node_instance SET interrupt_flag = 0 WHERE instance_code = #{instanceCode} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT id, instance_code, node_code, status, attempt, lease_owner FROM dag_node_instance WHERE status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_expire_time < #{now} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, instance_code, node_code, node_name, status, attempt, handler, max_retry, interval_sec, backoff, timeout_ms, input_params_json, output_json, lease_owner, lease_expire_time, interrupt_flag, cleanup_flag, error_msg, next_retry_time, skip_reason, stop_reason, version FROM dag_node_instance WHERE instance_code = #{instanceCode} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
